full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph shows a richly layered sitting room with rosy pink walls, green double doors and a floral upholstered chair. The doors occupy the center rear, framed in pale trim, while the chair sits in front of their right side and turns slightly toward the room. A deep patterned rug runs from the lower edge toward the doors, its burgundy, cream and dark blue motifs filling most of the floor. On the left, a bright window sends a narrow shaft of daylight across the wall and rug; heavy patterned drapery softens its edge. Beneath two small gilded pictures, a slim console supports dense arrangements of pink, red and pale flowers. The wall behind them carries oversized climbing floral imagery, so real blooms and painted ones seem to overlap. At the right, an ornate wooden side table holds a pale-shaded lamp and small decorative objects. Green leaves spread around the chair and into the darker right corner, where more framed pictures climb the wall. Upholstery, wallpaper, rug and carved furniture all carry separate patterns, but their warm pink, green, gold and burgundy colors bind the busy surfaces together. Daylight from the left brings bright highlights to the floral chair and rug; deeper shadow remains under the tables and behind the plants, while the lamp provides a mild warm accent. The photographic detail preserves fabric weave, glossy wood, glass reflections and layered leaves rather than smoothing them away. The overall composition feels densely furnished yet inviting, balancing a centered green doorway with abundant flowers and glowing patterned textiles.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形室内照片呈现层层铺陈的起居室：玫瑰粉墙面、绿色双开门和一把花布软垫扶手椅。双开门位于后方中央，周围是浅色门套；椅子放在门的右前方，略朝房间转向。一张深色花纹地毯从下缘伸向双开门，酒红、奶油白与深蓝图案占据大部分地面。左边的明亮窗户把一道窄日光投在墙面和地毯上，厚重花纹帘布使窗边柔和。两幅小金框画下，一张细长边桌承托密集的粉、红与浅色花束。其后墙面有大幅攀爬花卉图案，真花与画中花仿佛彼此叠合。右边，一张雕饰木边桌放着浅色灯罩台灯和小件摆设。绿叶围绕扶手椅展开，并伸入更暗的右侧角落；更多框画沿墙向上排列。椅面、墙纸、地毯与雕花家具各有不同纹样，但暖粉、绿色、金色与酒红色把繁忙的表面连在一起。左侧日光照亮花布椅和地毯，桌下与植物后仍留深影，台灯增添温和暖色重点。照片细节保留织物经纬、亮木表面、玻璃反光和层叠叶片，没有把它们抹平。整体构图陈设繁密却亲切，以居中的绿色门扇平衡丰盛花朵与发光的花纹织物。
style_prompt_en: A maximalist interior-photography treatment layers many distinct decorative patterns while binding them through a warm pink, leafy green, burgundy and antique-gold palette. Dense fine detail is distributed across most of the frame, with a few quieter central planes allowing the eye to rest. Soft natural light enters from one side in a narrow bright band, catching textured surfaces and falling into rich but readable shadow. Fabric weave, polished highlights, matte color, reflective glints and organic clusters remain separate tactile registers. Repeated curves and small motifs build a lush rhythm against larger rectilinear shapes. The composition uses depth and overlap rather than empty space for balance; the atmosphere is opulent, intimate and lived in.
style_prompt_zh: 极繁主义室内摄影处理叠加许多不同装饰纹样，同时以暖粉、叶绿、酒红与古金色把它们系在一起。密集细节分布于画面大部，少数较安静的中央色面让视线稍作停留。柔和自然光从一侧以窄亮带进入，照出有纹理的表面，再沉入浓郁却仍可辨识的阴影。织物经纬、抛光高光、哑光色面、反射亮点与有机簇群保持各自的触感层次。重复曲线与小纹样在更大的直线形状前建立丰盛节奏。构图依靠纵深与重叠而非空白取得平衡，气氛华丽、亲密且有人居住的温度。
theme_en: A flower-filled pink sitting room with a floral chair and green double doors
theme_zh: 布满鲜花的粉色起居室，摆着花布扶手椅和绿色双开门
name: Mario Buatta
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
